summary: @servicetitan/contentful ships install-time dropper that downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as shared Contentful UI components but its preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB single-line obfuscated file `math_init.js` (obfuscator.io-style string-array with rotator function `WV8StW` and array constant `n7gIxM`). Fetching an alternate JS runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling file on npm install bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners on the installer's host. The dropper is unrelated to the package's stated purpose: `dist/index.js` containing the actual Contentful code is only 88 bytes while `math_init.js` is 727,680 bytes. The scope `@servicetitan/*` and Contentful-themed metadata form a cover story around the install-time payload, consistent with a compromised or typosquatted scoped package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
